```{python}
#| label: fig-bench-coordcube-largen
#| fig-cap: "Large-N CoordCube capability"
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np

groups = ['N=6', 'N=12', 'N=19']
x = np.arange(len(groups))
w = 0.3

path_gen = [6.52, 17.5, 27.2]
kv_prox  = [81.4, 119, 106]

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(4.5, 3.5))
ax.bar(x - w/2, path_gen, w, label='Path gen r=0',  color='white', edgecolor='black', linewidth=0.8, hatch='///')
ax.bar(x + w/2, kv_prox,  w, label='KV prox r=0',   color='white', edgecolor='black', linewidth=0.8, hatch='')

ax.set_ylabel('Latency (ns)', fontsize=9)
ax.set_xticks(x); ax.set_xticklabels(groups, fontsize=8)
ax.legend(fontsize=7, loc='upper left')
ax.grid(axis='y', linestyle=':', alpha=0.4)

for xi, p, k in zip(x, path_gen, kv_prox):
    ax.text(xi - w/2, p + 2.0, f'{p}', fontsize=7, ha='center', va='bottom')
    ax.text(xi + w/2, k + 2.0, f'{k}', fontsize=7, ha='center', va='bottom')

plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
```
